title: Trying to insert to multiple tables from form with mysql
author: fredM
BrenBarn
text:
You didn’t show the part of your code that actually runs your query.  The error is saying that one of your parameters is a “builtin function or method”.
It’s hard to know for sure without seeing your code, but this can commonly be caused by forgetting to call a function when building the data you’re trying to insert.  Like maybe you have cursor.execute("INSERT INTO sometable VALUES (%s, %s)", (get_data(), get_otherdata)) and the problem is you put get_otherdata instead of get_otherdata(); this means it tries to insert the function get_otherdata itself, rather than the data you intended to get by calling that function.

author: AlSweigart
text:
You forgot the parentheses after strip on these two lines, so you’re assigning the strip() method itself, not it’s return value:
    Item_Date = entry_Date.get().strip
    Item_Cost = entry_Cost.get().strip
